name: The Thandol Span
summary: At the Thandol Span, Rhag Garmason waits for word from a missing scout. He sent adventurers to check on Ol' Ebenezer Rustlocke after the dwarf stopped reporting from the great stone crossing. The search beneath its arches reveals what happened to him and a threat to northern supply lines.

sections.title: A Scout's Final Stand
sections.body: Longbraid the Grim sent Ebenezer Rustlocke to watch over the Thandol Span's structure and security. When the scout stopped reporting, foul play was feared. Beneath the crossing's arches, you find Rustlocke dead. Dark Iron invaders ambushed him from the shadows.

sections.title: Deepfury's Orders
sections.body: A set of written orders bearing the name Deepfury lies near Rustlocke's clenched fingers. The parchment points to deliberate Dark Iron operations meant to destabilize the crossing, not a random robbery or isolated border skirmish. When you bring the evidence to Garmason, the garrison shifts from a routine search to urgent wartime defense.

faq.answer: Ebenezer 'Ol' Rustlocke was an Alliance dwarf sent to scout the Thandol Span and keep watch there. Dark Iron dwarves caught him off guard and killed him beneath the bridge.
Dark Iron operatives ambushed Rustlocke beneath the Thandol Span under orders from Kam Deepfury.

faq.q: What is found on Rustlocke's body?
faq.answer: A parchment containing Deepfury's Orders lies beside Rustlocke's clenched fist. It records covert Dark Iron plots against the northern bridge.
Rhag Garmason is an Alliance officer stationed south of the Thandol Span in the Wetlands. He secures traffic between the dwarven territories and the north.

faq.q: Why is the Thandol Span so heavily contested?
faq.answer: The Thandol Span is the only overland bridge linking Khaz Modan and the Wetlands with the Arathi Highlands and Lordaeron. The Alliance needs it for its supply lines.

faq.q: What happens after giving the orders to Rhag Garmason?
faq.answer: After you give Rhag Garmason the orders, he sends you to destroy a cache of Dark Iron explosives just across the span in the Arathi Highlands, thwarting their sabotage.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you learn that Dark Iron forces have reached far north of the Searing Gorge. Their infiltration threatens your kin in Ironforge.
As an Alliance member, you know the Thandol Span links Ironforge and Stormwind to northern Alliance strongholds. Rustlocke's discovery matters to the security of the continent.
